LESSON: READING 5.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION: NEWS AND ADVERTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts, part of Strand 5 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why is news important? 2. How are adverts used to promote trade?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. read a text based on the theme fluently for comprehension,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. interpret information from news and adverts for understanding,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge interpreting information from texts for lifelong learning.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. read a text based on the theme fluently for comprehension,

   Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. interpret information from news and adverts for understanding,

   Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. acknowledge interpreting information from texts for lifelong learning.

   Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. describe products based on their colour, size, shape and origin (adjectives),

2. with peers, read an advertisement on a product of choice at correct speed,

3. role play reading a news item fluently and at correct speed observing punctuation marks,

4. work jointly to interpret information from a news item and an advert,

5. make notes on the key ideas from the texts read in the news and advertisements,

6. work jointly with peers to design an advertisement on a product of choice. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. describe products based on their colour, size, shape and origin (adjectives),
2. with peers, read an advertisement on a product of choice at correct speed,
3. role play reading a news item fluently and at correct speed observing punctuation marks,
4. work jointly to interpret information from a news item and an advert,
5. make notes on the key ideas from the texts read in the news and advertisements,
6. work jointly with peers to design an advertisement on a product of choice. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem solving: This is cultivated as the learner interprets information from texts containing news and

adverts.

• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner role plays reading news items fluently and at correct

speed.

Values:
• Integrity: This is promoted as the learner displays transparency and honesty when designing advertisements of

products for consumers.

• Respect: This is cultivated as the learner appreciates diverse opinions when reading an advertisement on a product of

choice at correct speed.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial literacy: This is developed as the learner acquires knowledge on trade and use of advertisements to increase sales.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of news and advertisement to the concept of trade learnt in Social Studies.
